description: The installation of a 17.5 metre pole with six antennas within a shroud at the top of the pole, one dish externally mounted on the pole, four equipment cabinets enclosed by a fence.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (100 Rev A, 200 Rev A, 201 Rev A, 300 Rev A, 301 Rev A - Received 05/03/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The structure, antenna, and associated facilities will be removed if they become obsolete.

Condition : 4 - The pole and shroud shall be painted in British Racing Green - RAL 6005 - so as to appear congruous within the wider area unless a similar colour is agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Full product specifications of the compound fencing shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works. Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details.
Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the approved plans the door to the compound shall not open over the public highway.
